resources.string: This one-time tool lets Zyll Photo show up as a cloud media app in Android\'s photo picker, the screen other apps open when you choose a photo. Run it once, then you can uninstall it. Your setting stays.
Zyll Photo is not installed on this phone. Install it first, then come back.
Get Zyll Photo on Google Play
Adds Zyll Photo to the photo picker\'s list of allowed cloud media apps. Apps already on the list, such as Google Photos, are kept.
Puts the photo picker settings back to exactly what the system had before.
This tool only talks to your phone\'s own wireless debugging service. It does not connect to any server, and it collects no data.
Android\'s photo picker only offers cloud photos from apps on a system allowlist. Zyll Photo is not on the factory list, so it has to be added once using the system\'s debugging permission.
Using the system\'s own Wireless debugging, the helper opens a connection inside this phone only (not over the internet, not to other devices) and runs only these fixed commands:

Using Wireless debugging, the helper removes its own overrides, which brings back the system\'s original values. If an older Zyll build had added itself the other way, that entry is removed too. Only these commands run:
You can undo this any time with \"Undo in one tap\" on the first screen. You can also remove the helper\'s pairing in Developer options → Wireless debugging → Paired devices.
Turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options, choose \"Pair device with pairing code\", then type the 6-digit code into the helper\'s notification. It takes about a minute and needs Wi-Fi.
I understand and allow the helper to run these commands on this phone
Step 1: Turn on wireless debugging and pair

1. Tap the button below. The helper posts a notification for the code and opens Developer options.
2. Turn on "Wireless debugging", open it, and choose "Pair device with pairing code".
3. Keep that dialog open, pull down the notification shade, and type the 6-digit code into the helper's notification.
4. When you see "Paired", come back here. It continues on its own.
Can\'t find Developer options? Go to Settings → About phone and tap \"Build number\" 7 times.
Waiting for the code in the notification…
Wireless debugging was not found. Make sure it is turned on and the phone is on Wi-Fi.
Not paired yet. Do the pairing step above first.
Notification not working? Enter the port and code here
Open Settings and this helper in split screen. Enter the port number after the colon in \"IP address & Port\" in the pairing dialog, and the 6-digit code.
Zyll Helper: waiting for the pairing code
While \"Pair device with pairing code\" is open, tap here and type the 6 digits from the dialog.
Pairing port not found. Make sure the pairing dialog is still open and the phone is on Wi-Fi.
Go back to Zyll Helper to continue
Open the pairing code dialog again and retry.
Connected to wireless debugging. Tap the button to run the commands one by one. Each result is shown below.
Turn off wireless debugging when done (recommended)
Zyll Photo is now an allowed cloud media app. Last step: in the photo picker settings, choose Zyll Photo as the cloud media app.
The photo picker settings are back to the system\'s original values.
You no longer need this helper and can uninstall it. The setting stays. To undo later, install the helper again and tap \"Undo\".
Read the current cloud media allowlist
Add Zyll Photo to the allowlist (existing entries kept, not replaced by config syncs)
Make sure the photo picker\'s cloud media feature is on
Remove the helper\'s cloud media switch override
Remove an entry left by an older Zyll build
Remove an allowlist setting left by an older Zyll build
Turn off wireless debugging (the connection closes)
